summary: This bill requires both the Secretary of Commerce and a joint resolution of Congress to approve the export of advanced artificial intelligence semiconductors to the People's Republic of China, following an interagency review considering national security and other factors.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly restricts the export of advanced AI semiconductors to China, requiring both executive and congressional approval. This is a clear protectionist measure aimed at controlling specific high-tech trade, making it central to trade policy.
